title: Lupus Genetics Studies
brief_summary: The Lupus Genetics Studies and Lupus Family Registry \& Repository are working to find the genes that reveal the causes of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE, or lupus). The study is enrolling families of all ethnic backgrounds from the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, and the Virgin Islands that have one or more living members diagnosed with SLE.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Families in which one or more living members have been diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus
study_population: Patients diagnosed with SLE Families with living members diagnosed with SLE
